characters.name: भीम
characters.role: the strong one, incognito and hungry
characters.look: tall, broad-shouldered, dark-haired, simple dhoti, bare arms

characters.name: ब्राह्मण
characters.look: thin, grey-haired, white dhoti, worried face

characters.name: कुंती
characters.role: the mother who offers her son
characters.look: elder woman, plain sari, calm face

mentions.name: बकासुर
mentions.role: the demon who charges a monthly fee

hookAdvisory.note: States flatly that the demon's dinner ate the demon first, the central contradiction as plain fact.

lines.text: बकासुर का खाना मुफ्त में आया था, और खाने वाले ने खाना खा लिया।
lines.gloss: Bakasura's dinner arrived free of charge, and the one to be eaten ate the food instead.

look.note: Bhima sits by the tribute cart, already eating.

lines.text: बकासुर का हिसाब सीधा था। हर महीने एक आदमी, दो भैंसे और एक गाड़ी चावल।
lines.gloss: Bakasura's account was simple. Every month one man, two buffaloes and a cart of rice.

look.note: The brahmin and Kunti stand by the loaded cart at the village edge.

lines.text: बारी बहुत सालों बाद आती थी, पर आज ब्राह्मण की बारी थी। उसके पास खरीदने के लिए कुछ नहीं था।
lines.gloss: The turn came after many years, but today it was the brahmin's turn. He had nothing to buy a substitute with.

look.note: The brahmin shrugs with empty palms at his hut door.

lines.text: ब्राह्मण ने कहा, "मेरे पास कोई विकल्प नहीं।" तभी कुंती अपने बेटे को आगे करके बोलीं।
lines.gloss: The brahmin said, "I have no option." Then Kunti pushed her son forward and spoke.

look.note: The brahmin talks with open hands; Kunti steps forward beside him.

lines.text: भीम वायु का बेटा था, ताकत में दस हज़ार हाथी। उसने बस इतना कहा, "ठीक है।"
lines.gloss: Bhima was the wind god's son, with the strength of ten thousand elephants. He just said, "Fine."

look.note: Bhima stands tall and nods once; Kunti watches him.

lines.text: लेकिन जो आदमी खुद खाया जाने जा रहा था, वह गाड़ी का चावल क्यों खा रहा था?
lines.gloss: But why was the man going to be eaten himself eating the cart's rice?

look.note: Bhima sits beside the cart, rice in hand, looking up.

lines.text: दरअसल, भीम जंगल में खाना ले गया और खुद खाने लगा, ज़ोर से बकासुर को पुकारते हुए।
lines.gloss: Actually, Bhima carried the food to the forest and began eating it himself, loudly calling Bakasura.

look.note: Bhima shouts into the forest clearing with a handful of rice.

lines.text: यह वैसा ही था जैसे कोई पार्सल देने वाला खुद पार्सल खोलकर बैठ जाए। बकासुर आया, तो थाली खाली थी।
lines.gloss: It was like a delivery man opening the parcel himself and sitting down. Bakasura arrived, and the plate was empty.

look.note: Bhima points at the empty vessels in the clearing.

lines.text: बकासुर ने पूछा कि उसके सामने कौन खा रहा है। भीम ने जवाब नहीं दिया, खाते रहे।
lines.gloss: Bakasura asked who was eating in front of him. Bhima gave no answer and kept eating.

look.note: Bhima sits and eats, facing the clearing.

lines.text: फिर उसने भीम की पीठ पर ज़ोर का वार किया। भीम ने थाली पूरी की, हाथ धोए, और मुस्कुराकर खड़े हो गए।
lines.gloss: Then he struck Bhima hard on the back. Bhima finished the plate, washed his hands, and stood up smiling.

look.note: Bhima stands up with a smile, empty vessels behind him.
